ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, points D and E are on sides $AB$ and $AC$, respectively. If $DE \parallel BC$ and $\frac{AD}{DB} = \frac{2}{3}$, $DE = 6\,\text{cm}$, then what is the length of $BC$ in cm?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\frac{AD}{DB}=\frac{2}{3}$,\\
it follows that $\frac{AD}{AB}=\frac{2}{5}$,\\
Since $DE\parallel BC$,\\
it implies $\triangle ADE\sim \triangle ABC$,\\
thus $\frac{AD}{AB}=\frac{DE}{BC}$, and given $DE=6$,\\
it means $\frac{6}{BC}=\frac{2}{5}$,\\
therefore $BC=\boxed{15}$, which is verified to be in accordance with the problem statement;
